headline: Foreign Currency Purchases of $17 Billion Push Dollar Toward R$ 6 in Brazil
summary: Foreign investors bought nearly $17 billion in Brazilian foreign exchange derivatives over a three-week period, driving the US dollar closer to the 6.00 reais threshold amid local fiscal scrutiny.
why: Brazil's exchange rate influences imported inflation and sovereign interest rate expectations set by the Central Bank of Brazil.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Heavy foreign dollar derivative purchases pushed the exchange rate near 6.00 reais.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The US dollar approached R$ 6 as international funds executed nearly $17 billion in net foreign exchange derivative purchases amid domestic fiscal concerns.
